title: Profile prediction-head hparams wrapper (v0.1.0a9 documentation snapshot)
description: Documentation-owned schema snapshot for ProfilePredictor entries under hparams.predictor in exact release v0.1.0a9. Not a canonical runtime definition. Runtime also requires profile_loss.type == profile_cross_entropy and count_loss.type == log1p_mse, and at least one positive head weight across the model.
